timeline.summary: Refex Industries secured a ₹32.12 Cr order for transporting pond ash to NHAI PWD road construction sites over 1 year.
Refex Industries announced a change in its shareholding in subsidiary Venwind Refex Power Limited to 73.28% following a rights issue and debt conversion.
Refex Industries announced that the Madras High Court quashed an income tax demand of ₹35.67 lakh for AY 2016-17.
Refex Industries' 1,11,70,000 convertible warrants (₹468 each, part of a ₹905.44 Cr preferential issue) lapsed on May 06, 2026 unconverted, and the ₹130.69 Cr upfront 25% was forfeited.
Refex Industries reported that 1.11 crore convertible warrants lapsed on May 06, 2026, resulting in the forfeiture of ₹130.69 Cr in upfront subscription monies.
Refex Industries secured a ₹36.50 Cr order for supplying bulk industrial commodity to a Navratna PSU, executable in ~40 days.
Refex Industries secured a ₹20.27 Cr logistics and material handling order from a Miniratna PSU, executable in 6 months.

Refex Industries Limited, via Ankit Poddar (ACS-25443), scheduled an earnings call for Q4 & FY26 results on May 28, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST with Mr. Anil Jain (Chairman & MD) and Mr. Dinesh Kumar Agarwal (WTD & CFO) participating.
Refex Industries Limited rescheduled its Q4 & FY26 earnings call from May 28 to May 27, 2026, at 12:30 PM IST due to Bakrid holiday.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹934.17 Cr (+48.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹90.82 Cr (+88.0% YoY).
Refex Industries reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹701.0 Cr and PAT of ₹93.7 Cr.
Refex Industries secured a ₹36.91 Cr order for excavation, loading, and transportation of pond ash from a major power producer.
Refex Industries reported Q4 FY26 standalone continuing revenue of ₹701 Cr and PAT of ₹94 Cr, bolstered by ash handling growth and wind energy execution.
Refex Industries announced that the Joint Commissioner (Appeals), Central GST, Raipur quashed a GST demand of ₹35.29 lakh for FY 2021-22.
Refex Industries Limited’s Management Representatives will hold an Analyst/Institutional Investor Meet in Mumbai on June 11, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Refex Industries reported Q1FY27 standalone revenue of ₹619 Cr (+76% YoY) and PAT of ₹73.6 Cr (+123% YoY), with ash handling business maintaining 17% EBITDA margin and wind business transitioning to active delivery phase with ₹295 Cr revenue.
15-Oct-2026: CIT(A)-20 Chennai partly allowed Refex's AY2014-15 appeal, deleting a ₹36.40 lakh depreciation disallowance and remanding the ₹17.48 Cr LTCG addition for fresh quantification.

15-Oct-2026: Commissioner (Appeals), CGST & Central Excise, Bhopal allowed Refex's appeal, vacating a ₹29.32 Cr tax-and-penalty demand and making ₹5.87 Cr paid under protest eligible for refund/re-credit.
Refex Industries bagged a ₹32.45 Cr rate contract for ash transportation from a Maharatna PSU.

22-Oct-2026: Refex Industries received a one-year slab-wise rate contract for ash transportation to NHAI/PMGSY road project sites from Vikas Coal and Minerals, with a cumulative maximum award value of ₹31.13 Cr incl. GST.
Refex Industries Limited schedules earnings call for Q2 FY27 results with **Mr. Anil Jain (Chairman & MD)** and **Mr. Dinesh Kumar Agarwal (WTD & CFO)** on October 29, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST.
